card.name: Capital H starting liver and blood terms
card.fires_on: The capital letter H that begins an all-caps medical word such as HEPATIC, HEPATOMEGALY, HEMOLYTIC or HEMATOLOGIC. It appears in boxed warnings and headings written in capitals.

modes.label: HEPAT- words
modes.description: H opening liver terms like hepatic, hepatomegaly or hepatotoxicity in capitals.
modes.example: LACTIC ACIDOSIS AND SEVERE<< H>>EPATOMEGALY WITH STEAT

modes.label: HEM- words
modes.description: H opening blood terms like hemolytic or hematologic in capitals.

card.writes: It pushes toward liver-related word starts such as liver and Hep, and away from unrelated name pieces.
card.plain: It marks the first letter H of capitalized liver or blood terms in warning headings.
